research_highlights: Cebu Leg 3 (Sept 13, 2026) offers 5K, 10K, 21K and 32K distances, with the 32K required to complete the official Trilogy progression that qualifies runners for the National Finals marathon category.
The 32K distance in Leg 3 is branded the 'Afroman' distance, described by organizers as the point where runners hit 'the wall' before the final push toward marathon distance.

The event is organized by RUNRIO in partnership with Santé International as part of a five-city nationwide series (Manila, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Cagayan de Oro) culminating in a National Finals at SM Mall of Asia on November 8, 2026.
Registration fees vary by early vs. late registration periods, and Race Roster registration includes additional processing, web, and delivery charges on top of published fees.
Runners can mix-and-match legs across different host cities to complete the Trilogy progression, though bundle registration discounts are restricted to a single city.

faqs.question: When is the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Cebu Leg 3 taking place?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on September 13, 2026. It will be held at SM Seaside in Cebu City, Philippines. This is part of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series, organized by Runrio, and marks the third leg of the Cebu edition.

faqs.question: What distances can participants run?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distance categories: 32km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. The 21.1km half-marathon distance is listed as the primary distance for this event, giving runners of varying experience levels several options to select from when registering.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The event is organized by Runrio, operating under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand. Runrio manages this race as part of the broader Trilogy Run Asia series, with this specific edition being held in Cebu City, Philippines, as the third leg of that series.

faqs.question: Is registration open yet?
faqs.answer: According to available information, registration for this race has not yet been announced. Interested participants will need to wait for further details from the organizer, Runrio, regarding sign-up dates, fees, and procedures for the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Cebu Leg 3.
